what: PW-2 on TI's LM27762 transient model (circuit of lm_tran 'su_5.25_max') with per-capacitor loop inductance, through simtools.pw2 and the shared ngspice runner, in the PCB image sha256:d59d53c2f00faee77709bf0e65fdf1a713b1a4a6785345d0ddb3a10c174f0531 (ngspice 45.2)
reference_lm_tran: 0.16 mV pk-pk on OUT+, 20.7 mV on VIN, pump 1.39 MHz, OUT+ 3.4177 V, OUT- -2.0553 V (kvm_02, ngspice 47)
finding: The ideal case (no inductance) converges and reproduces the reference. Every case with series inductance on the capacitors stalls ('Timestep too small') inside TI's model: at the pump start-up (405-412 us) at every damping tried (1 ohm to 1 kohm across L) and every step (0.25, 0.5, 1 us); and with the inductors shorted through start-up and released at 0.8 or 0.9 ms it stalls 10 us after the release. The model does not accept an inductance step on its capacitors. No L-sensitivity figure was obtained; none is claimed.
